decisions.statement: Both apps compile this one tile rather than each carrying a copy of it.
The age drawn is the oldest reading any tile of the app holds.
A feed counts while a tile placed on the phone asks for it.
Which tiles are placed is read off WidgetKit rather than worked out from use.
A feed no placed tile asks for is left out of the age and out of the count.
A tile is set beside its feed through the pairing its own provider wrote.
A tile gone from the phone is asked for a picture, and that picture is fetched.
The tile names the feed that oldest reading came from.
A feed is named by the last part of its path.
A reading's moment is written only where that reading decoded.
An age still climbing is a refresh that did not land.
The age counts up while nothing of the tile's is running.
The whole tile is the button asking every tile of the app to reload.
This tile fetches nothing and says nothing about what a reading is.

definition: the tile saying how old the oldest reading the other tiles hold is
